title: NumericDate integers
description: Restates HCERT Specification, 3.2.5 Expiration Time; HCERT Specification, 3.2.6 Issued At; RFC 8392 CBOR Web Token (CWT). HCERT Specification, 3.2.5 Expiration Time: “SHALL hold a timestamp in the integer NumericDate format”.

statements.label: NumericDate integers
statements.requirement: iat and exp SHALL be encoded as integer NumericDate (seconds since the epoch). The decoder SHOULD accept floating-point NumericDate and truncate it.

successCriteria.criterion: A test named after STT-CWT-002 passes in each implementation's suite (Kotlin: `STT-CWT-001 STT-CWT-002 claim keys are integers and dates are integer NumericDates` (BuildCwtTest.kt)).
